test-implementation.description: Controlled planned-owner inputs only; they are not actual Git changes.

fixtures.query: Identify the v1.2.0 workflow, prompt-generation, lifecycle, correction-routing, command, and compatibility owners required to design a structured workflow-instruction catalog and packet assembly without changing native stage order or production behavior.

Retrieve pre-implementation owner, dependency, contract, validator, constant, error, schema, caller, callee, closest-test, and backward-compatibility evidence for the anticipated v1.2.1 workflow catalog, resolver, packet assembly, and bounded prompt integration surfaces. No production changes exist yet.

Retrieve controlled pre-implementation test context for planned v1.2.1 owner surfaces, including changed-surface evidence, production symbols, contracts, validators, errors, test infrastructure, test commands, responsibility mappings, freshness, adequacy, budget, truncation, and provenance. Changed inputs are synthetic fixture data, not Git changes.

limitations: The published 1.10.2 package installs a CLI that reports 1.0.0 and lacks the role-aware context command; the verified clean local 1.10.2 build produced these fixtures.

Requests use index without root because the verified normalizer rejects root with an external index unless it is exactly root/.my-dev-kit; generated indexes were required to stay outside repositories.
upstreamArtifactRefs is accepted and validated but is deferred and does not affect retrieval.
Jest configuration is detected but only Vitest configuration discovery is implemented.
Freshness is unknown because the fixture has one active index and no before/after index identity.
The request-level string-array responsibility shape cannot carry orchestrator-owned criticality.
normalizationRules: replace the absolute orchestrator worktree with <ORCHESTRATOR_REPO_ROOT>
replace request, output, and audit paths with their fixture placeholders
replace remaining Batch 0 temporary-root paths with <BATCH0_TEMP_ROOT>
normalize path separators to forward slashes
recursively sort object keys while preserving array order
serialize as UTF-8, two-space JSON, with one final newline
warnings: Orchestrator criticality in test-strategy-sample.txt is intentionally not represented by my-dev-kit mappings, which default these request IDs to noncritical.
Implementation and test-implementation role adequacy record required evidence-group truncation; the contextAdequacy conclusion remains sufficient with listed assumptions.
